title: Amorphous indium–zinc oxide layer with transport and protective dual-function for high-efficiency semitransparent and tandem Sb2(S,Se)3 solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04699D, Paper
Junjie Yang, Jianyu Li, Yuehao Gu, Rongfeng Tang, Lei Huang, Zhiyuan Cai, Bo Che, Qi Zhao, Shuwei Sheng, Hong Wang, Changfei Zhu, Tao Chen
Bifunctional IZO was soft-sputtered for semitransparent Sb2(S,Se)3 solar cells, achieving the highest efficiency both in semitransparent and all-antimony-based tandem devices.
